answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A falcon ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A zephyr expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A summit renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 717 identities cost 3757 paid peers, 154234 tokens of stake and 32540 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
